semantics: Every formatting-related source repair discovered in a researcher PDF must be proposed here before its release is called governed. Global repair modifies only canonical shared style/rules after tests; scoped variation gets a registered extension. No automatic unreviewed propagation to other theses.
science_boundary: Scientific content changes do not become global LaTeX appearance rules
